doc: n5-look (r2_w4): the rocket blast flings grey concrete slabs in a bold ink edge and small ink specks out past its fireball (WeaponFxDebris, render only, seeded by the blast's position). chunk_m = slab size range (m); fly_k = [start, end] distance as a share of the splash radius, eased out over ticks; fill = the slab's flat grey; edge_px = its ink edge (world px); specks / speck_px = the ink dots flung with them; chunks 0 = no debris (before); `--blast-debris=off` = the before for an A/B. Iteration 12 (r2_w4's few big chunks among many small): chunk_big = that many slabs, spread round the blast, take the top quarter of chunk_m and the rest its lower 60 % (0 = the uniform sizes); chunk_m 0.35-1.3 -> 0.3-1.5 with chunk_big 3.
